title.heading: Wyndleford Parish Church
title.subheading: A church website that follows the church year: Sundays with readings and hymns, a calendar, ministries and small groups, and members-only directory, prayer list and rota.

end.heading: Built with Raytha
end.subheading: Open-source .NET CMS. Get the brief, screenshots and a one-command rebuild kit.

scenes.caption: Home: this Sunday's bulletin, with the readings, hymns and preacher, under a ribbon of the whole church year
The church year as a wheel, drawn on the server from the seasons and their dates
Pick a season and the whole site takes its colors
The calendar: a month grid with each day's season and the name of every Sunday
A Sunday: readings, hymns, the preacher and the sermon text
Signed out, the directory, prayer list and rota stay on the server
Signed in as a member: the volunteer rota, with your own slots and swaps wanted
